nparashar150-claude-keyboard-shortcuts-k.description: Audit a web app for missing keyboard shortcuts and implement them end to end: a command registry, context-scoped bindings, a command palette, visible kbd hints, a ? help sheet, invariant tests, and WCAG 2.1.4 compliance. Use whenever the user mentions keyboard shortcuts, hotkeys, keybindings, a command palette, Cmd+K, power-user features, or making an app feel fast, and also when building or reviewing any list, table, modal, form, or editor UI where shortcuts and keyboard access obviously belong even if the user never says the word shortcut.
